en: Welcome back! You did great,{SAUT}Naoto-kun, Futaba-chan!
Yes, I was very impressed with both{SAUT}Futaba's memory and Shirogane-san's{SAUT}analysis skills.{PAGE}Thanks to you two, we were able to{SAUT}solve the crime.
Good work!{OPTION}A perfect pair.{OPTION}It's all thanks to me.
Ohh! You sound like a police chief!
Thank you. It makes me happy to hear{SAUT}you say that.{PAGE}Of course, we mustn't forget we had{SAUT}your help as well, {f 6 1 30 0 0 0}-san.

*chuckle* You were a great partner,{SAUT}Futaba-san. I would very much enjoy{SAUT}working with you again.
C'mon... Let them have their moment.
*chuckle* Of course, we couldn't have{SAUT}done it without your leadership,{SAUT}{f 6 1 30 0 0 0}-san.

Oh, maybe Akechi-san can go next{SAUT}time. It'll be the old Detective Prince{SAUT}versus the new one!

Haha. Hopefully, I can be of some{SAUT}help.{PAGE}By the way, what I saw today was{SAUT}great. It truly helped broaden my{SAUT}horizons.{PAGE}Should we ever get the chance,{SAUT}allow me to assist you, Detective Prince.
